set.body:
Source: 2026-08-03 full-codebase review.

Problem:
worker/RegisteredTaskLauncher.scala set umask 077 only in remoteScriptLaunchBytes
(the opaque-script path, where BatchSuite asserted it). The local array, remote
array dispatch, bounded shard, and gang rank scripts all open stdout.log and
stderr.log with shell redirects and set no umask, so those logs were created with
the site default -- routinely world-readable on a shared cluster. Workload logs can
carry input values and diagnostics.

Severity is bounded by the parent directories, which AtomicFiles already creates
restrictively, so this is defense in depth rather than a confirmed disclosure. It
is filed at p2 for that reason.

Acceptance:
- umask 077 precedes the first redirect in every script that creates a log.
- Verified as a property over every generated .sh rather than a per-path
  assertion, so a future script builder that redirects before setting umask fails
  the suite. Demonstrated RED against the parent commit.
set.title: P8.A10: Create workload logs private in every generated launch script
